audit.evidence: Real WordPress + real ASE plugin zips (7.6.2 v0 / 7.6.3 v1) built via compose; external HTTP entry ?reset-for on wp init handler + admin-ajax pcb_secret flag read. Live --run-gate observed: original(profile_update) reaches flag on v0, blocked on v1; bypass(set_user_role) reaches flag on v1. v2(8.8.4) residual closure documented in repro.log (both paths 403). Oracle gate is Variant A (v0/v1); it self-tears-down.
audit.note: This oracle exposes no --with-v2 flag; automated live gate covers the 3-way Variant A differential, v2-blocked verified manually per repro.log.

flag.resource: admin-only secret returned by the mu-plugin admin-ajax action `pcb_secret` (gated by current_user_can('manage_options')); planted at /flag/pcb_flag.txt
flag.placement: environment canary (mu-plugin), NOT ASE/WP business code
flag.detect: flag token substring in candidate result

mechanism.vulnerable_action: ASE 'View Admin as Role' role-restoration handler View_Admin_As_Role::role_switcher_to_view_admin_as() on `init`, `?reset-for=<username>` branch (no auth/nonce/capability check; runs for UNAUTHENTICATED requests)
mechanism.cve1_guard: 7.6.3 added maybe_prevent_switchback_to_administrator() hooked ONLY on `profile_update`, deleting the stale `_asenha_view_admin_as_original_roles` meta + allow-list entry when the victim is demoted via the profile-edit screen
mechanism.cve2_residual: the `profile_update`-only cleanup misses other WP role-API demotion paths (WP_User::set_role() -> `set_user_role`, e.g. Users-list bulk change); stale meta survives so unauth `?reset-for` still restores administrator. Fixed in 8.8.4 (adds `set_user_role` cleanup + hashed-token reset).
mechanism.differential: same reset-for sink/flag channel; original demotes via profile_update (blocked on V1), residual demotes via set_user_role (reaches flag on V1)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2026-12083 is an incomplete fix of CVE-2024-43333 / CVE-2025-24648, which closed the issue for only one of the demotion paths the WordPress role API exposes.

status.review_reason: Compose references a registry image; human must confirm target ownership

provenance.notes: V0=7.6.2 (7.6.2.1 unavailable on wordpress.org; 7.6.2 is <=7.6.2.1 so vulnerable to CVE-2024-43333). CVE-2024-43333 fixed in 7.6.3; residual persists 7.6.3->8.8.3; CVE-2026-12083 fixed in 8.8.4 (confirmed by source diff).
